policy.rule: Only verified content should become the long-term canonical answer when a native-speaker review is available. Sourced content may remain in the course but must not be presented as dialect-universal.
notes: Do not fabricate conversational forms to fill coverage gaps.
Keep accepted alternatives when reliable spoken variants are known.
Prefer natural household speech over mechanically generated textbook forms.
Record reviewer, region/dialect context and evidence for every native-reviewed or verified change.
